answer:
Both revisions are complete and the final deliverable now carries all eleven required artifact keys with the actual files.

(1) Artifact population: the submission artifacts dictionary now includes every required key with its native relative path and actual file content: simulation.py, final_coords.npy, order_parameter_trajectory.npy, order_parameter_histograms.npy, heat_capacity_curve.npy, temperature_observables.json, transition_free_energy_profile.npy, q_energy_joint_histograms.npy, native_contact_probability.npy, transition_analysis.json, visualization.png. No new simulation was needed beyond the rerun required to embed the WHAM correction into the single pipeline script.

(2) WHAM multi-histogram reweighting: implemented in simulation.py as a Ferrenberg–Swendsen WHAM over all six temperature slices using the saved per-frame Q and energy data. Binned on the same 50 deterministic Q bins, per-bin mean energies averaged across temperatures (standard WHAM approximation for a temperature-only bias), density of states e(Q) obtained by fixed-point iteration to convergence |Δf| < 1e-12 (a fixed-point solve, not an optimizer on the landscape), then reweighted to β* = 1/T_star. Updated transition_free_energy_profile.npy (row 0 = Q bin centers, row 1 = F(Q) at T_star in kBT*, minimum shifted to zero, empty bins finite-clipped to the profile maximum, 6.338 kBT*), and recomputed modes/mode separation/barrier/mean from that reweighted distribution in transition_analysis.json. T_star (0.70255 from the <Q>=0.5 midpoint) and peak_heat_capacity (43.088 from the fluctuation curve) are unchanged, as agreed.

Corrected transition numbers: order_parameter_at_transition_mean = 0.5112 (WHAM-reweighted mean at T_star — a strong consistency check, since the midpoint construction implies ≈0.5); modes at Q = 0.53 and 0.61 (separation 0.08); free-energy barrier 2.13 kBT*. The reweighted profile at T_star is a broad single basin spanning Q ≈ 0.3–0.65 with its global minimum at Q = 0.55 and rising ~6 kBT* toward both Q→0 and Q→1; the second reported mode is a shallow ripple on the basin's shoulder (barrier ~2 kBT*, comparable to kBT*), so the landscape at T_star is best described as one broad fluctuating basin with sub-state structure rather than a clean two-state folded/unfolded split. All other results (per-temperature <Q> = [0.716, 0.560, 0.378, 0.380, 0.345, 0.280], strongly negative Q–energy correlations −0.59…−0.85, Jaccard 0.46, empty warnings list) stand; visualization.png was regenerated so its free-energy panel shows the WHAM profile.
